title: Fastned - Kia EV3 Standard Range 58,3 kWh (2024+) charge graph
notes: Charge graph embedded in the Fastned vehicle page (EV3 Standard Range 58,3 kWh (2024+), charger class 400), one kW value per SoC %, read with curl. Page carries no reuse terms and the Fastned terms of use have no clause on vehicle chart data (owner confirms). Fastned says curves assume a battery near 30 C.
